Project: cafe loyalty points tracker
Component: Role-Based Access Control

Purpose: Ensure only authorized staff members can access sensitive features like customer management and transaction logs

Required export shape: Export the Express middleware function as a named export literally called `middleware`, fully typed - e.g. `import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express"; export function middleware(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void { ... }`. IMPORTANT: this middleware is mounted globally with app.use(middleware), so it runs on EVERY request to the server - every route, every method, including plain GET requests that carry no body. Unless the purpose says it protects every request (e.g. authentication), first check req.method and req.path and call next() immediately for any request the purpose does not cover; only validate or reject the requests it is actually about. If it checks tokens (e.g. a JWT), it MUST verify the signature before trusting anything in the token: HMAC-SHA256 with createHmac and timingSafeEqual from "node:crypto", keyed by process.env.JWT_SECRET, and reject every token when JWT_SECRET is unset. Decoding a token without verifying its signature is not authentication - anyone could forge one.

Project: Birthday Reminder App
Component: User Authorization
Domain: security
Purpose: Ensures that users can only access and modify their own birthday records through proper authentication and authorization checks
Target file: backend/src/middleware/user-authorization.ts
Required export shape: Export the Express middleware function as a named export literally called `middleware`, fully typed - e.g. `import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express"; export function middleware(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void { ... }`. No default export. IMPORTANT: this middleware is mounted globally with app.use(middleware), so it runs on EVERY request to the server - every route, every method, including plain GET requests that carry no body. Unless the purpose says it protects every request (e.g. authentication), first check req.method and req.path and call next() immediately for any request the purpose does not cover; only validate or reject the requests it is actually about. If it checks tokens (e.g. a JWT), it MUST verify the signature before trusting anything in the token: HMAC-SHA256 with createHmac and timingSafeEqual from "node:crypto", keyed by process.env.JWT_SECRET, and reject every token when JWT_SECRET is unset. Decoding a token without verifying its signature is not authentication - anyone could forge one.
Available npm packages: express
Allowed local imports: none - this file must have no local (relative) imports
Architectural constraints already declared for this project: none.

IMPORTANT: this middleware is mounted globally with app.use(middleware), so it runs on EVERY request to the server - every route, every method, including plain GET requests that carry no body. Unless the purpose says it protects every request (e.g. authentication), first check req.method and req.path and call next() immediately for any request the purpose does not cover; only validate or reject the requests it is actually about. Decoding a token without verifying its signature is not authentication - anyone could forge one.
